question: How many days a week can employees work remotely?
ground_truth: Employees can work remotely up to three days a week.
source_context: Employees at Acme Corp are allowed to work remotely up to three days a week.

question: What are the core hours when working remotely?
ground_truth: The core hours are from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM in the employee's local time zone.
source_context: However, employees must be available during core hours, which are from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM in their local time zone.

question: How many days of paid time off (PTO) do full-time employees get?
ground_truth: Full-time employees are entitled to 20 days of paid time off per calendar year.
source_context: All full-time employees are entitled to 20 days of paid time off per calendar year.

question: Does unused PTO roll over to the next year?
ground_truth: No, unused PTO does not roll over to the next year.
source_context: Unused PTO does not roll over to the next year, so we encourage everyone to use their time.

question: What is the annual stipend for professional development?
ground_truth: Every employee receives an annual stipend of $1,000 for professional development.
source_context: Every employee receives an annual stipend of $1,000 to be used for professional development.
